name: TBE Review & Reply
facts: Technical review aligns requirements, vendor replies, evidence and review state.
No supporting evidence leads to a clarification request, not a fabricated conclusion.
Linked relevant evidence can support a draft; applicability and final judgment remain human.
Original text, changes and rationale are retained; no internal records or performance claims are public.
seeds: Evidence desk: physical document leaves, ruled clauses, optical highlights and an unresolved evidence gap.
Alignment matrix: horizontal requirement lanes and response/evidence columns, compare by moving an illuminated review band.
Reply press: document fragments enter a deliberate printing mechanism that withholds unsupported output.
Revision palimpsest: translucent source and draft sheets reveal annotations, provenance and preserved originals.
Review relay: a clause travels across evidence and human-review checkpoints, with a true pause when evidence is absent.

data.reply: Refer to the proposed equipment schedule.
